title: Origins: Revenant
description: Origin datapack that adds the Revenant, an origin based on the Stray.
body:
Origin datapack that adds the Revenant, an origin based on the Stray.

Skeletal creatures of the deep tundra, the Revenants are greatly experienced with bows.

![Revenant Power List](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32e87ae50ddd4e6bf744d478f08b8d34fa0762fe.png)
